singleRule._comment: HAPPY PATH: Single SR entry + single reg entry. SR 5:00-8:00(3h) at 2x. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) at 1x. Gap 8:00-9:00 unallocated. SR pay=3*1*2=6, bill=3*2*2=12. Reg pay=8, bill=16. Total=14pay,28bill.
HAPPY PATH: Single entry spanning SR+gap+reg (boundary crossing). Entry 5:00-17:00. SR=5:00-8:00(3h). Gap=8:00-9:00(1h unallocated). Reg=9:00-17:00(8h). Same totals as 001.
HAPPY PATH: Single SR + multiple reg WITH GAP. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). Reg 9:00-12:00(3h)+13:00-17:00(4h)=7h. Gap 12:00-13:00 unlogged. SR=6, Reg=7. Total=13pay,26bill.
HAPPY PATH: Single SR + multiple reg WITHOUT GAP (contiguous). SR 5:00-8:00(3h). Reg 9:00-12:00+12:00-15:00+15:00-17:00=8h. SR=6, Reg=8. Total=14pay,28bill.
HAPPY PATH: Multiple SR entries WITH GAP + single reg. SR 5:00-6:00(1h)+7:00-8:00(1h)=2h (gap 6-7). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). SR=4, Reg=8. Total=12pay,24bill.
HAPPY PATH: Multiple SR entries WITHOUT GAP (contiguous) + single reg. SR 5:00-6:30(1.5h)+6:30-8:00(1.5h)=3h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). SR=6, Reg=8. Total=14pay,28bill.
HAPPY PATH: Multi SR WITH GAP + multi reg WITH GAP. SR 5:00-6:00+7:00-8:00=2h. Reg 9:00-12:00+13:00-17:00=7h. SR=4, Reg=7. Total=11pay,22bill.
HAPPY PATH: Multi SR WITHOUT GAP + multi reg WITHOUT GAP (contiguous). SR 5:00-6:30+6:30-8:00=3h. Reg 9:00-12:00+12:00-15:00+15:00-17:00=8h. SR=6, Reg=8. Total=14pay,28bill.
HAPPY PATH: Multi SR WITH GAP + multi reg WITHOUT GAP. SR 5:00-6:00+7:00-8:00=2h. Reg 9:00-12:00+12:00-15:00+15:00-17:00=8h. SR=4, Reg=8. Total=12pay,24bill.
HAPPY PATH: Multi SR WITHOUT GAP + multi reg WITH GAP. SR 5:00-6:30+6:30-8:00=3h. Reg 9:00-12:00+13:00-17:00=7h. SR=6, Reg=7. Total=13pay,26bill.
SR AFTER REGULAR (19:00-22:00, 2h gap). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) + SR 19:00-22:00(3h). Gap 17:00-19:00 unallocated. SR=6, Reg=8. Total=14pay,28bill.
SR AFTER, single entry spanning reg+gap+SR. Entry 9:00-22:00. Reg=8h, gap=2h, SR=3h. Reg=8, SR=6. Total=14pay,28bill.
SR ADJACENT BEFORE regular (7:00-9:00, NO gap). Entry 7:00-17:00. SR=7:00-9:00(2h). Reg=9:00-17:00(8h). No gap between SR and Reg. SR=4, Reg=8. Total=12pay,24bill.
SR ADJACENT AFTER regular (17:00-22:00, NO gap). Entry 9:00-22:00. Reg=8h. SR=17:00-22:00(5h). No gap. Reg=8, SR=10. Total=18pay,36bill.
SR ADJACENT BEFORE (7:00-9:00), clean split entries. Entry1: 7:00-9:00(SR 2h). Entry2: 9:00-17:00(Reg 8h). SR=4, Reg=8. Total=12pay,24bill.

BOUNDARY CROSSING: entry spans SR end + gap + reg start. SR=5:00-8:00. Entry 7:30-9:30 splits: SR=7:30-8:00(0.5h), gap=8:00-9:00(1h unalloc), Reg=9:00-9:30(0.5h). Plus Reg 10:00-17:00(7h). Total Reg=7.5h, SR=0.5h. SR=1, Reg=7.50. Total=8.50pay,17bill.
BOUNDARY: Entry ends exactly at SR range end (8:00). SR 5:00-8:00. Entry 6:00-8:00(2h in SR). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). SR=4, Reg=8. Total=12pay,24bill.
BOUNDARY: Entry starts exactly at SR range start (5:00). SR 5:00-8:00. Entry 5:00-6:30(1.5h in SR). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). SR=3, Reg=8. Total=11pay,22bill.

BOUNDARY: Entry overlaps SR end by small margin. SR 5:00-8:00. Entry 7:45-8:15(30min). SR portion=7:45-8:00(0.25h). Gap=8:00-8:15(0.25h unalloc). No reg entry. SR pay=0.25*2=0.50. Total=0.50pay,1bill.
BOUNDARY: Entry overlaps SR start. Entry 4:30-6:00(1.5h). Before SR=4:30-5:00(0.5h unalloc). SR=5:00-6:00(1h). Plus Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). SR=2, Reg=8. Total=10pay,20bill.
ONLY SR hours on weekday (single entry). No regular work. SR 5:00-8:00. Entry 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6. Total=6pay,12bill.
ONLY SR hours on weekday (multiple entries with gaps). SR 5:00-8:00. 5:00-6:30(1.5h)+7:00-8:00(1h)=2.5h. SR=5. Total=5pay,10bill.
GAP ZONE ONLY: Entry ENTIRELY in gap zone. SR 5:00-8:00, Reg 9:00-17:00. Entry 8:15-8:45(0.5h). Not in SR (ends at 8:00), not in Reg (starts at 9:00). All unallocated. Pay=0, Bill=0.

TWO RANGES (before+after): User works all three zones. SR1=5:00-8:00(2x), SR2=19:00-22:00(2x). Mon: SR1 5:00-8:00(3h)+Reg 9:00-17:00(8h)+SR2 19:00-22:00(3h). SR total=6h, SR pay=6*2=12, bill=6*4=24. Reg=8,16. Total=20pay,40bill.
TWO RANGES (before+after): User works ONLY one range (SR1) + regular. SR1=5:00-8:00, SR2=19:00-22:00. No work in SR2. SR=6, Reg=8. Total=14pay,28bill.

TWO RANGES (both after regular): SR1=18:00-20:00, SR2=21:00-23:00. Gap 20:00-21:00 between ranges. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h)+SR1 18:00-20:00(2h)+SR2 21:00-23:00(2h). SR total=4h, SR pay=8, bill=16. Reg=8,16. Total=16pay,32bill.

TWO RANGES (both after): Single entry spanning SR1+gap+SR2. Entry 18:00-23:00(5h). SR1=18:00-20:00(2h), gap=20:00-21:00(1h unalloc), SR2=21:00-23:00(2h). Plus Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). SR=8, Reg=8. Total=16pay,32bill.

TWO RANGES with DIFFERENT MULTIPLIERS. SR1=5:00-8:00(2x), SR2=19:00-22:00(3x). Mon: 5:00-8:00(3h)+9:00-17:00(8h)+19:00-22:00(3h). SR1 pay=3*2=6,bill=3*4=12. SR2 pay=3*3=9,bill=3*6=18. Combined SR=[15,30]. Reg=8,16. Total=23pay,46bill.
TWO RANGES: single mega entry spanning SR1+gap+reg+gap+SR2. SR1=5:00-8:00(2x), SR2=19:00-22:00(2x). Entry 5:00-22:00. SR1=3h, gap1=1h, Reg=8h, gap2=2h, SR2=3h. SR=12, Reg=8. Total=20pay,40bill.
TWO RANGES same side: partial work in each. SR1=18:00-20:00, SR2=21:00-23:00. Mon: 18:00-19:00(1h SR1)+22:00-23:00(1h SR2). No reg. SR total=2h. SR=4, Reg=0. Total=4pay,8bill.
MULTI-DAY Mon+Tue. SR 5:00-8:00. Mon: 5:00-8:00(3h SR)+9:00-17:00(8h Reg). Tue: 6:00-8:00(2h SR)+9:00-17:00(8h Reg). Mon: SR=6+Reg=8. Tue: SR=4+Reg=8. Total=26pay,52bill.
WEEKEND: SR on Sat (day off, rule applied). SR 5:00-8:00 on Sat. Sat: 5:00-8:00(3h SR). All at 2x. SR=6. Total=6pay,12bill.
WEEKEND: SR on Sat+Sun+Mon. Sat: 6:00-8:00(2h). Sun: 5:00-7:00(2h). Mon: 5:00-8:00(3h SR)+9:00-17:00(8h Reg). Total SR=7h(14pay), Reg=8. Total=22pay,44bill.
WEEKEND: Sat work entirely OUTSIDE SR range. SR 5:00-8:00 on Sat. Sat: 10:00-15:00(5h). All unallocated (not in SR, no reg on Sat). Pay=0, Bill=0.
WEEKEND NOT IN RULE: SR applied Mon-Fri only. User works Sat 5:00-8:00 during SR time range. Since rule NOT applied on Sat, all unallocated. Pay=0, Bill=0.
FULL 5-DAY WEEK: Mon-Fri each with SR+Reg. SR 5:00-8:00. Each day: 5:00-8:00(3h SR)+9:00-17:00(8h Reg). Per day: SR=6+Reg=8=14. 5 days=70pay,140bill.

singleRule._comment: MULTI-DAY MIXED: Mon has SR+Reg, Tue has ONLY regular (no SR work). SR 5:00-8:00. Mon: 5:00-8:00(3h SR)+9:00-17:00(8h Reg). Tue: 9:00-17:00(8h Reg). Mon SR=6+Reg=8. Tue Reg=8. Total=22pay,44bill.

BPN ant=0: Break in SR zone. SR 5:00-8:00(3h) break 6:00-6:30(0.5h). SR work=2.5h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). Effective Reg=8h, Reg=8. SR=5. Total=13pay,26bill.

BPN ant=0: Breaks in BOTH SR and Reg. SR 5:00-8:00(3h) brk 6:00-6:30(0.5h). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-12:30(0.5h). SR work=2.5h, Reg work=7.5h. ant=0 effective=8, 7.5<8 OK. SR=5, Reg=7.50. Total=12.50pay,25bill.
BPN ant=0: Multiple breaks in SR (contiguous). SR 5:00-8:00(3h) brks 6:00-6:30+6:30-7:00=1h. SR work=2h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). SR=4, Reg=8. Total=12pay,24bill.
BPN ant=0: Multiple breaks in SR (spaced). SR 5:00-8:00(3h) brks 5:30-6:00+7:00-7:30=1h. SR work=2h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). SR=4, Reg=8. Total=12pay,24bill.
BPN ant=0: NO break taken. SR 5:00-8:00(3h) + Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). breakBillable=No but 0 breaks. SR=6, Reg=8. Total=14pay,28bill.

BPN ant=0: Multiple entries with gap + break. SR 5:00-6:00+7:00-8:00=2h. Reg 9:00-12:00+13:00-17:00=7h brk 14:00-14:30(0.5h). Reg work=6.5h. ant=0, effective=8, 6.5<8 OK. SR=4, Reg=6.50. Total=10.50pay,21bill.

BPN ant=1h, break==ant: Single SR + single Reg. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-13:00(1h). ant=3600(1h). Effective=7h. Actual Reg work=8-1=7h=Effective. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=7. Total=13pay,26bill.

BPN ant=1h, break==ant: Break in SR (1h) + break in Reg (1h). ant=3600. Effective=7. Actual break in Reg=1h, Reg work=7=Effective. SR brk deducts from SR only: SR work=2h. SR=4, Reg=7. Total=11pay,22bill.

BPN ant=1h, break==ant: Multi SR + multi Reg + breaks. SR 5:00-6:00+7:00-8:00=2h brk in 5:00-6:00:[5:15-5:30]=0.25h. Reg 9:00-12:00+13:00-17:00=7h brk 14:00-15:00(1h). ant=3600. Effective=7. Reg scheduled=7h, actual break in Reg=1h, Reg work=min(7-1,7)=6h. SR work=1.75h. SR=3.50, Reg=6. Total=9.50pay,19bill.
BPN ant=1h, break>ant: Break 2h > ant 1h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-14:00(2h). ant=3600. Effective=7. Actual Reg work=8-2=6 < 7 so Reg=6. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=6. Total=12pay,24bill.
BPN ant=1h, break>ant: Break 3h > ant 1h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brks 11:00-12:00+13:00-15:00(3h). Reg work=8-3=5 < 7. Reg=5. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=5. Total=11pay,22bill.
BPN ant=1h, break>ant: Break in both SR(1h)+Reg(2h). SR 5:00-8:00(3h) brk 6:00-7:00(1h). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-14:00(2h). SR work=2h, Reg work=min(8-2,7)=6h. SR=4, Reg=6. Total=10pay,20bill.

BPN ant=1h, break<ant: Break 0.5h < ant 1h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-12:30(0.5h). ant=3600. Effective=7. Reg work=min(8-0.5,7)=min(7.5,7)=7h. 0.5h unallocated. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=7. Total=13pay,26bill.
BPN ant=1h, break<ant: NO break taken (0 < 1h). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). ant=3600. Effective=7. Reg work=min(8,7)=7h. 1h unallocated. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=7. Total=13pay,26bill.

BPN ant=1h, break<ant: Break 0.25h + break in SR 0.5h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-12:15(0.25h). SR 5:00-8:00(3h) brk 6:00-6:30(0.5h). Effective Reg=7. Reg work=min(8-0.25,7)=7. SR work=2.5h. SR=5, Reg=7. Total=12pay,24bill.
BPN ant=2h: break==ant. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-14:00(2h). ant=7200(2h). Effective=6. Reg work=min(8-2,6)=6h. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=6. Total=12pay,24bill.
BPN ant=2h: break<ant (1h). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-13:00(1h). ant=7200(2h). Effective=6. Reg work=min(8-1,6)=6. 1h unallocated. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=6. Total=12pay,24bill.
BPN ant=2h: break>ant (3h). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 11:00-14:00(3h). ant=7200(2h). Effective=6. Reg work=min(8-3,6)=5. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=5. Total=11pay,22bill.
BPN ant=30min (1800s): break==ant. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-12:30(0.5h). ant=1800. Effective=7.5h. Reg work=min(8-0.5,7.5)=7.5. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=7.50. Total=13.50pay,27bill.

BPN ant=30min (1800s): break<ant (15min). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-12:15(0.25h). ant=1800. Effective=7.5. Reg work=min(7.75,7.5)=7.5. 0.25h unalloc. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=7.50. Total=13.50pay,27bill.
BPN ant=30min (1800s): break>ant (1h). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-13:00(1h). ant=1800. Effective=7.5. Reg work=min(7,7.5)=7. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=7. Total=13pay,26bill.
BPN ant=45min (2700s): no break taken. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h). ant=2700(45min=0.75h). Effective=7.25. Reg work=min(8,7.25)=7.25. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). SR=6, Reg=7.25. Total=13.25pay,26.50bill.
BPN ant=1h: SINGLE ENTRY spanning SR+gap+reg with break in Reg. Entry 5:00-17:00. SR=3h, gap=1h, Reg=8h. Break 12:00-13:00(1h==ant). Effective=7. Reg=7. SR=6, Reg=7. Total=13pay,26bill.

BPN ant=1h: SINGLE ENTRY spanning SR+gap+reg, break in SR. Entry 5:00-17:00. Break 6:00-7:00(1h in SR). SR work=2h. Reg 8h. ant=3600 but 0 break in Reg: Effective=7, Reg capped at 7. SR=4, Reg=7. Total=11pay,22bill.

BPN ant=1h: BREAK SPANNING SR+gap+reg boundary (3 zones). Entry 5:00-17:00. Break 7:00-10:00(3h). SR portion=7:00-8:00(1h deducted from SR). Gap=8:00-9:00(1h discarded). Reg portion=9:00-10:00(1h deducted from Reg). SR work=2h. Reg scheduled=8h minus 1h Reg break=7h, capped at Effective=7. SR=4, Reg=7. Total=11pay,22bill.
BPN ant=1h: Multi SR WITH GAP + single Reg + break in Reg. SR 5:00-6:00+7:00-8:00=2h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-13:00(1h==ant). Effective=7. Reg=7. SR=4, Reg=7. Total=11pay,22bill.

Reg scheduled=7h, Reg break=1h, Reg work=min(6,6)=6h (effective=8-1-1=7-1=6? No: Effective=8-1=7. Reg scheduled is 7h(not 8h because entries total 7h). Reg work=min(7-1,7)=6h). SR=5, Reg=6. Total=11pay,22bill.

BPN ant=1h: Multi entry, break<ant. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). Reg 9:00-12:00+13:00-17:00=7h brk 14:00-14:30(0.5h<1h). Effective=7. Reg work=min(7-0.5,7)=min(6.5,7)=6.5h. SR=6, Reg=6.50. Total=12.50pay,25bill.
BPN ant=1h: Multi entry, break>ant. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). Reg 9:00-12:00+13:00-17:00=7h brk 10:00-11:00+14:00-15:00(2h>1h). Effective=7. Reg work=min(7-2,7)=5h. SR=6, Reg=5. Total=11pay,22bill.
BOUNDARY BPN: Break at EXACT START of SR. SR 5:00-8:00(3h) brk 5:00-5:30(0.5h). SR work=2.5h. ant=3600, no Reg break. Effective=7. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) capped at 7. SR=5, Reg=7. Total=12pay,24bill.
BOUNDARY BPN: Break at EXACT END of SR. SR 5:00-8:00(3h) brk 7:30-8:00(0.5h). SR work=2.5h. ant=3600, no Reg break. Effective=7. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) capped at 7. SR=5, Reg=7. Total=12pay,24bill.

BOUNDARY BPN: Break SPANNING SR→gap boundary (7:30-8:30). SR portion=7:30-8:00(0.5h). Gap portion=8:00-8:30(0.5h discarded). Entry 5:00-9:00+9:00-17:00. SR work=2.5h. ant=3600, no Reg break. Effective=7. Reg=8 capped at 7. SR=5, Reg=7. Total=12pay,24bill.

EDGE BPN: SR fully consumed by break (0 SR work). SR 5:00-6:00(1h) brk 5:00-6:00(1h). ant=3600, no Reg break. Effective=7. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) capped at 7. SR=0, Reg=7. Total=7pay,14bill.

EDGE BPN: MAX 10 BREAKS in single SR entry. SR 5:00-8:00(3h). 10 breaks of 6min each=1h. SR work=2h. ant=3600, no Reg break. Effective=7. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) capped at 7. SR=4, Reg=7. Total=11pay,22bill.
WEEKEND BPN: SR on Sat with break. ant=1800(30min). SR 5:00-8:00 on Sat. Sat: 5:00-8:00(3h) brk 6:00-6:30(0.5h). SR work=2.5h. No Reg on Sat so ant only impacts Reg. SR=5. Total=5pay,10bill.
WEEKEND BPN: Sat+Mon. Sat: SR 5:00-8:00(3h) brk 6:00-7:00(1h), SR work=2h. Mon: SR 5:00-8:00(3h)+Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-13:00(1h==ant). Sat SR=4. Mon: SR=6, Reg=7. Total=17pay,34bill.

MULTI-DAY BPN: Mon+Tue. ant=3600. Mon: SR 5:00-8:00(3h)+Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-13:00(1h). Tue: SR 6:00-8:00(2h)+Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-14:00(2h>ant). Mon Reg=7, Tue Reg=min(6,7)=6. Mon SR=6, Tue SR=4. Total=23pay,46bill.
BPN ONLY SR: Single SR entry with break, no Reg entry. ant=3600. SR 5:00-8:00(3h) brk 6:00-6:30(0.5h). SR work=2.5h. No Reg to cap. SR=5. Total=5pay,10bill.
BPN ONLY SR: Multi SR entries with break. SR 5:00-6:30+7:00-8:00=2.5h brk 5:30-6:00(0.5h). SR work=2h. No Reg. SR=4. Total=4pay,8bill.

BPN MULTI-RANGE: TWO ranges (before+after), break in SR1. ant=3600. SR1=5:00-8:00 brk 6:00-6:30(0.5h). SR2=19:00-22:00. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-13:00(1h==ant). SR1 work=2.5h, SR2 work=3h, SR total pay=2.5*2+3*2=11. Reg=7. Total=18pay,36bill.

BPN MULTI-RANGE: TWO ranges, breaks in BOTH ranges. ant=3600. SR1=5:00-8:00 brk 6:00-6:30(0.5h). SR2=19:00-22:00 brk 20:00-20:30(0.5h). Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-13:00(1h==ant). SR1 work=2.5h, SR2 work=2.5h, SR total pay=10. Reg=7. Total=17pay,34bill.

BPN MULTI-RANGE: Break spanning gap between two SR ranges. SR1=18:00-20:00, SR2=21:00-23:00, gap 20:00-21:00. Entry 18:00-23:00 brk 19:30-21:30(2h). SR1 portion=0.5h, gap=1h, SR2 portion=0.5h. All unpaid(BPN). SR1 work=1.5h, SR2 work=1.5h, SR=3h(pay=6). Plus Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) brk 12:00-13:00(1h==ant). Reg=7. Total=13pay,26bill.

BPN MULTI-RANGE: Different multipliers. ant=3600. SR1=5:00-8:00(2x), SR2=19:00-22:00(3x). Reg brk 12:00-13:00(1h==ant). SR1 3h, SR2 3h. SR1 pay=6, SR2 pay=9. Reg=7. Total=22pay,44bill. SR1 bill=12, SR2 bill=18. Reg bill=14.
